name: Jiang Yanggu, Alone
description: An Echoverse Jiang Yanggu, feared by bandits and assassins in Shenmeng, who seeks vengeance for the death of Mowu.

description_citations.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Mowu is killed by unknown assailants and Yanggu casts aside his peaceful ways.
timeline.quote: When Mowu was killed by unknown assailants, Yanggu cast aside his peaceful ways, craving only vengeance.

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.
